description: Implement the Remuneration module: salary scale display by sector, indexed salary calculation, and salary alerts. Replace the current placeholder page with a functional module.
steps: Replace src/app/remuneration/page.tsx with a full module page that shows: (1) Tab navigation between 'Baremes' (salary scales), 'Indexations' (indexation history), and 'Simulations' (salary calculator), (2) Default view shows salary scales table grouped by sector from seniority_scales table

Create src/app/remuneration/baremes/page.tsx - Salary scales display: (1) Fetch seniority_scales joined with sectors, (2) Display as a table grouped by sector showing years of seniority and base_salary, (3) Allow filtering by sector

Create src/app/remuneration/indexations/page.tsx - Indexation history: (1) Fetch organisation_indexations and sector_indexations, (2) Display chronological list of indexations with dates and values, (3) Show current cumulative indexation factor

Create src/app/remuneration/simulateur/page.tsx - Salary simulator: (1) Select an employee from dropdown, (2) Auto-fill their sector, seniority years, and work percentage from timesheets, (3) Calculate indexed salary = base_salary (from seniority_scale) * cumulative indexation * work_percentage, (4) Display the calculation breakdown
Ensure the remuneration routes share the Sidebar + Header layout
acceptance_criteria: The /remuneration page shows a tabbed navigation to Baremes, Indexations, and Simulateur
The /remuneration/baremes page displays salary scales from Supabase grouped by sector
The /remuneration/simulateur page calculates indexed salary for a selected employee
verification: npm run build passes without errors
findings: Used 'as unknown as Type[]' pattern for Supabase joined query results due to TypeScript inference returning arrays for FK relations. Layout already existed at src/app/remuneration/layout.tsx.
